outcome: Abdominal muscle thickness (upper rectus abdominus, lower rectus abdominus, external oblique, internal oblique, transversus abdominus)
cohort: The study included 80 nulliparous women and 76 mothers who had delivered vaginally within the past 4 weeks.
finding: Postpartum women (within the first month of delivery) had significantly thinner rectus abdominus muscles (upper and lower) and internal oblique muscles compared to nulliparous women.
cross-section timing: Postpartum women were assessed within 1 month (or past 4 weeks) of delivery.
